def: SWAP-K: recipient's S_K := donor's S_K (K = think_k), the decoder on the recipient's own dec tokens; U = {donor final, cf_a(t = 1)}; follow_U = share of swap answers in U; floor = share in U of the MEAN-K answers (S_K := the mean of the 1,000 donors' S_K) on the same recipients; binding follow_U >= 0.50 and >= floor + 0.30 (the scorer's)
